name: ingress_5xx
description: ingress-nginx access-log lines whose response status is 5xx. Anchored on the status after the request line; an unanchored " 5xx " also matches the request-length field.

name: eso_reconcile_errors
description: External Secrets Operator reconcile failures (the controller's own error log line).

name: job_warning_events
description: Kubernetes Warning events on Jobs and CronJobs in commonly-dev (BackoffLimitExceeded, DeadlineExceeded, FailedCreate). The managed kube-state-metrics package exports no Job or CronJob series, so a failed backup is visible only here.
filter: logName:"logs/events" AND resource.type="k8s_cluster" AND jsonPayload.involvedObject.namespace="commonly-dev" AND jsonPayload.involvedObject.kind=("Job" OR "CronJob") AND jsonPayload.type="Warning"
